remarks: Beautifully Updated garden level Heywood Heights condo nestled in a park-like setting. Spacious, ground floor one bedroom condo has an open floor plan with New kitchen opening to the dining area & living room with triple slider leading to your own quiet patio that is surrounded by the lush, landscaped courtyard. The kitchen has plenty cabinet space & breakfast bar overlooking the Living Room & Courtyard. The large bedroom has an oversized closet just outside the door, and the New modern Full Bath complete the picture. Washer/Dryer conveniently located in the unit. New HVAC (2022) New Lighting includes recessed LED, wall & switch plates. This sought after complex offers an In-ground pool & clubhouse with his/hers sauna. Great location - just minutes to downtown, all commuting and Stamford beaches.
